resources.string: Add and check foods, get Pro
Opson Builders photograph packs they have at home to add missing foods and check the ones already here. Every food you add or check helps everyone who scans it after you.
Pro, free, while you're active. Ten accepted foods or checks in 30 days keeps it on. You get your first month as soon as you join.
Add a food: photograph the front, the nutrition label and, if you like, the ingredients. Your phone reads the label and fills in the numbers for you to check.
Check a food: on any food from a pack you have, choose Check against the pack and photograph its label.
See something wrong? Report it from the food, as anyone can.
Photograph only packs you have in front of you. No photos from websites, other apps or other people.
Don't copy numbers from other apps or databases. Type what the label says.
Opson keeps your photos for review and publishes the food data, as the privacy policy says.
One account per person. There's no payment, and Opson can change or end the program with notice.
Fake or copied data means removal from Builders, the end of Builder Pro and removal of your contributions. It can also mean a ban.
